map.F 为何取大/小？: Why put the larger variance in the numerator?
map.通常把大方差放分子使 F≥1，与单尾临界比较；方差齐性检验看双尾。: Putting the larger variance in the numerator keeps F≥1 for comparison with a one-tailed critical value, while homogeneity of variance tests use both tails.
